owner_rules: Done means ALL evidence: implemented as specified (task id), a test that FAILED before and passes now, suites green, measured number vs target, docs regenerated, committed AND pushed to the contract's branch.
Never defer: no "later", "follow-up", "out of scope". If blocked: what blocks, what you tried, what you need; then continue with the next task.
Root cause, then fix: file:line + mechanism. No weakening tests, raising timeouts, skips, relaxed assertions.
No silent scope cuts: never lower targets, caps or test sizes without owner approval.
Never bypass guards: no --no-verify, no bypass env vars, no skip flags.
Deliver continuously: one task per commit, pushed to the contract's branch as it goes green.
Honest reporting: TASK-ID | status | commit | tests | measured vs target | missing.

tasks.title: Sensitive-path gate
requirements: scripts/gate/sensitive-paths.json lists the sensitive globs by area: command execution (src/engine/contracts.mjs, src/cli/runner.mjs, src/cli/setup-remote.mjs, src/engine/setup-channel.mjs, src/cli/contracts-cli.mjs), auth and tokens (src/server/oauth.mjs, src/engine/tokens.mjs, src/engine/devices.mjs, src/engine/sshsig.mjs when it exists), the tunnel and relay (src/cli/tunnel.mjs, src/engine/relay*.mjs, src/server/http.mjs), the oplog (src/engine/oplog.mjs, src/engine/vault.mjs), the daemon's network face and entry points (src/server/main.mjs, bin/memev.mjs, Dockerfile, compose*.yaml, scripts/install.sh, scripts/install.ps1, scripts/release-tarball.mjs), licences and seats (src/engine/license.mjs, src/engine/entitlements.mjs, src/cli/invite.mjs), and every workflow (.github/**)

scripts/gate/sensitive-paths.mjs --base <sha> lists the changed files that match; when any does, it requires the checklist named by the sensitive diff id described below (or the file named by --checklist) with the four headings Who can call this, What runs, What survives a restart, What happens with two processes, each followed by at least one non-empty line that names a file:line; the binding is that checklist's Diff: line, and a Head: line, when present, only records where the checklist was written and never needs to resolve
exit 1 with the missing answers named; exit 0 when no sensitive file changed or the checklist is complete; the script has no dependencies and carries a version: comment

the checklist is bound to content, not to a commit: the gate computes the sensitive diff id, the sha256 over the sorted lines '<path> <blob id at the base> <blob id at the head>' (the word absent for a side where the path does not exist) of every sensitive path that differs between base and the head, and requires security/checklists/<first 12 hex of that id>.md with a line Diff: <the full id>; the id is the same on the pull request branch, on its merge ref and on main after a squash or a rebase merge, and any later change to a sensitive file, on the branch or on the base, changes it, so the binding goes stale (a revert to older content gets a new id, because its base content differs); a checklist copied to another change applies only when that change carries the identical sensitive content
the gate fails closed: when the changed files cannot be computed (unknown base, the all-zero sha, no merge base, a shallow history) it exits non-zero naming why, or treats every file as changed

the sensitive globs are read from the base commit and from the head and merged, so a change that removes a glob cannot excuse itself; a change to the gate script, its glob file, any file under .github/ or the hook template is itself sensitive
an answer counts only when it is not TODO, n/a or a repeat of another answer, and cites a file:line that exists at the head being checked

every run judges with the base's gate: CI runs the gate script and the glob file as they are at the base commit, never the copy in the change under review (QL-1.05 runs them from a checkout of the base); the pre-push hook runs the copy at the remote's head of the pushed branch, or of main for a new branch, and refuses when that copy is missing
the gate takes --head as well as --base and the hook passes the pushed sha from pre-push stdin, so pushing a branch from another checkout is judged on what is pushed

the checklist and every cited file are read through git at the head being checked (git show and git cat-file with execFile argument arrays, never a shell string), never from the working tree; a cited path or a ref with shell metacharacters, a quote or a leading '-' is refused with a message naming the refused characters, before git is called

callers of the command wrappers (src/engine/util.mjs run, src/engine/git.mjs) and vendor/attest are command-execution files for the sensitive list, found by scanning imports of those modules, not only of node:child_process
merge commits are judged on their combined content against the base, so an evil merge or a parallel branch cannot carry a sensitive change past a checklist written for another diff

the import and keyword scan also counts every tracked file that reads or sets MEMEV_BIND, MEMEV_TRUST_GATEWAY or MEMEV_GATEWAY, calls .listen(, imports node:net, node:http, node:https or node:tls, or calls crypto.verify or createVerify

each changed sensitive file that exists at the head is cited by at least one answer; a sensitive file the change deletes cannot be cited and is exempt from that rule; when the base has meanwhile changed the same sensitive file, the binding is stale and the gate names it, and docs/DEVELOPING.md says so

when the base commit has neither scripts/gate/sensitive-paths.json nor scripts/gate/sensitive-paths.mjs (the change that brings the gate in), the head's globs are used alone; a base that has the gate script but no glob file fails closed, and so does a base glob file that exists but fails to parse or yields no glob

each red-green criterion of this task that runs test/gate-sensitive.test.mjs has its own subtest whose name starts with <task>-cNN: (NN is the criterion's position in this task, so T1-c01: for the first), and the criterion runs only that subtest

criteria.statement: A diff touching oplog.mjs without a checklist fails, with a checklist missing one answer fails naming it, with a complete checklist for the same head passes, and a docs-only diff passes without one

verifier.cmd: out=$(node --test --test-reporter=tap --test-name-pattern='^T1-c01:' test/gate-sensitive.test.mjs 2>&1); rc=$?; printf '%s\n' "$out" | tail -30; [ $rc -eq 0 ] && printf '%s\n' "$out" | awk -v pat='^T1-c01:' 'BEGIN { n = split(pat, alt, "|") } function flush(  i) { if (cand != "") for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (cand ~ alt[i]) hit[i] = 1; cand = "" } /^[[:space:]]*(not )?ok [0-9]+ - / { flush(); name = $0; sub(/^[[:space:]]*(not )?ok [0-9]+ - /, "", name); if ($0 ~ /^[[:space:]]*ok / && name !~ /# (SKIP|TODO)/ && name !~ /\.test\.m?js$/) cand = name; next } /^[[:space:]]*type: .suite./ { cand = "" } END { flush(); for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (!hit[i]) exit 1; exit 0 }'

criteria.statement: The checklist folder explains the four questions

In a fixture repo: (a) commit A edits src/engine/oplog.mjs; commit B adds only the checklist made by the procedure in security/checklists/README.md; then `git merge --no-ff` onto the base to mimic refs/pull/N/merge. (c) A checklist saved under the current sensitive diff id's file name but whose Diff: line names another id: exit 1. (d) --checklist pointing at a complete checklist whose Diff: line names another id: exit 1.

tasks.title: Wired into the push hook
requirements: memev contract hook installs a pre-push hook that runs the gate beside memev gate
docs/DEVELOPING.md names the sensitive areas and the four questions

the hook is written where git reads it (git rev-parse --git-path hooks/pre-push), so linked worktrees and core.hooksPath work; it reads the refs from pre-push stdin; it runs the sensitive-path gate only in a repository that has opted in with git config memev.sensitiveGate true, which docs/DEVELOPING.md tells this repository's developers to set; whether to run is decided from that setting and the gate copy at the remote commit, never from the working tree; a repository that has not opted in runs no code read from its remote and exits 0, and the hook fixtures of this task that expect the gate to run opt in first
the installed hook passes the launcher and the workdir to sh as quoted data, so a path holding $( ), a backquote or a double quote is never run as code

each red-green criterion of this task that runs test/gate-sensitive-wiring.test.mjs has its own subtest whose name starts with <task>-cNN: (NN is the criterion's position in this task, so T2-c01: for the first), and the criterion runs only that subtest
